subject: Re: Air freight quote request to RUH
body:
Dear Alex,

Thank you for confirming the air freight booking. Please confirm once collection from our site in postcode 21505 is booked.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer acknowledges the air freight booking and asks to be kept informed once collection is booked, without accepting or asking a shipment question that needs an answer.
